rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken way to tell someone to move aside or out of the way.

example.english: Could you move aside a little so I can bring out a chair?
example.traditional: 唔該你行開啲，等我拎張櫈出嚟。
example.jyutping: m4 goi1 nei5 haang4 hoi1 di1 dang2 ngo5 ling1 zoeng1 dang3 ceot1 lei4

rows.note: Use this specifically when setting aside the fact that something was a joke, as in “joking aside.”

example.english: Joking aside, we really need to deal with this matter seriously.
example.traditional: 講笑還講笑，呢單嘢真係要認真處理。
example.jyutping: gong2 siu3 waan4 gong2 siu3 ni1 daan1 je5 zan1 hai6 jiu3 jing6 zan1 cyu2 lei5
